headline: Trump threatens ‘tremendous penalties’ for US tech firms that build datacenters abroad

members.title: Trump threatens ‘tremendous penalties’ for US tech firms that build datacenters abroad
members.lead: President gives wide-ranging White House press conference and says he has ‘fantastic relationships’ with Putin and Xi Donald Trump threatened on Friday to impose “tremendous penalties” on American tech companies that build datacenters outside the US, though he gave no details and told reporters he had not yet informed his own officials about the plan. In a discursive press conference from the White House briefing room, Trump also said he would “look into” the report that Iran had been planning to possibly detonate a “dirty bomb” in Washington DC, and backed JD Vance over comments the vice-president made blaming Republican midterm losses on the Iran war. Continue reading...

members.title: Vance stops short of endorsing Trump’s claim that Iran was close to nuclear weapon
members.lead: US vice-president says it’s not his place to second-guess the president, but refrains from endorsing Trump’s claim At a White House news conference on Friday, JD Vance stopped short of endorsing Donald Trump’s claim that Iran was so close to obtaining a nuclear weapon in February that it was essential for the US to go to war with the Islamic republic. In the White House briefing room, Trump was asked about reporting this week that he was unhappy with the US vice-president’s statement blaming Republican losses in the midterm elections on the Iran war.
